issues.jp_before: この問題[もんだい]{は|wa-topic}どうやって解[と]く{かな|kana-wonder}。
issues.problem: どうやって解くかな is stilted for 'how should I solve it'; the volitional form is the natural self-question.
issues.action: Changed to 解[と]こう{かな}; rewrote why.

issues.jp_before: ホテル{は|wa-topic}駅[えき]{から|kara-from}遠[とお]い{の|no-final}？
issues.problem: Distractor な: rising 遠いな？ is a real casual confirmation question, close to the English.
issues.action: Replaced な with さ.

issues.jp_before: 切符[きっぷ]{は|wa-topic}もう買[か]った{の|no-final}？
issues.problem: Distractor な: もう買ったな？ ('you've bought it, right?') is acceptable with nearly the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced な with さ.

issues.jp_before: このバス{は|wa-topic}市役所[しやくしょ]{の|no-possessive}前[まえ]{を|o-path}通[とお]る{の|no-final}？
issues.problem: Distractor な usable as a rising confirmation question.
issues.action: Replaced な with さ.

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]{で|de-place}迷[まよ]った{の|no-final}？
issues.problem: Distractor な usable as a rising confirmation question.
issues.action: Replaced な with さ.

issues.jp_before: 一人[ひとり]{で|de-scope}東京[とうきょう]{へ/に|e-direction}行[い]く{の|no-final}？
issues.problem: Distractor な usable as a rising confirmation question.
issues.action: Replaced な with さ.

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]{の|no-possessive}日[ひ]{も|mo-also}自転車[じてんしゃ]{で|de-means}行[い]く{の|no-final}？
issues.problem: Distractor な usable as a rising confirmation question.
issues.action: Replaced な with さ.

issues.jp_before: 駅前[えきまえ]{に|ni-location}新[あたら]しい店[みせ]{が|ga-subject}できた{の|no-final}？
issues.problem: Distractor な usable as a rising confirmation question.
issues.action: Replaced な with さ.

issues.jp_before: 空港[くうこう]{まで|made-until}、何[なん]{で|de-means}行[い]く{の|no-final}？
issues.problem: 何で is ambiguous between 'by what means' and なんで 'why', so the で slot is not a clean de-means slot; also a fourth use of 行く in the file.
issues.action: Rewrote as 空港[くうこう]{まで|made-until}どのくらいかかる{の|no-final}？ 'How long does it take to get to the airport?'; f=1.

issues.jp_before: ほら、早[はや]く電車[でんしゃ]{に|ni-target}乗[の]る{の|no-final}！
issues.problem: Distractors よ and ぞ: ほら、早く乗るよ！/乗るぞ！ are natural urgings with essentially the same force as the command.
issues.action: Distractors changed to な, ね, わ.

issues.jp_before: 信号[しんごう]{を|o-object}よく見[み]{て|te-sequence}、渡[わた]る{の|no-final}！
issues.problem: Distractors よ and ぞ: 渡るよ！/渡るぞ！ are acceptable urgings close to the English.
issues.action: Distractors changed to な, ね, わ.

issues.jp_before: 切手[きって]{は|wa-topic}一枚[いちまい]いくらだ{っけ|kke-recall}？
issues.problem: Unnatural English 'How much is a stamp each again?'.
issues.action: English changed to 'How much is one stamp again?'; lv 4→3.

issues.jp_before: 駅前[えきまえ]{の|no-possessive}スーパー{は|wa-topic}何時[なんじ]{に|ni-time}閉[し]まるん{だっけ|kke-recall}？
issues.problem: Slot answer だっけ inconsistent with the rest of the file, where だ stays outside and the slot is っけ.
issues.action: Changed to 閉[し]まるんだ{っけ|kke-recall}; why updated; lv 4→3.

issues.jp_before: 今日[きょう]{は|wa-topic}何[なに]{を|o-object}買[か]うんだ{っけ|kke-recall}？
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the next item (…何を買うんだっけ).
issues.action: Replaced with あのケーキ屋[や]{は|wa-topic}予約[よやく]{が/は|ga-subject}要[い]るんだ{っけ|kke-recall}？ 'Does that cake shop need a reservation? I can't recall.' lv3.

issues.jp_before: このレストラン{は|wa-topic}カード{が|potential-ga}使[つか]えるん{だっけ|kke-recall}？
issues.problem: Slot was だっけ (inconsistent); the が slot lacked the equally natural は alternative.
issues.action: Changed to カード{が/は|potential-ga}使[つか]えるんだ{っけ|kke-recall}; lv 4→3.

issues.jp_before: 昨日[きのう]{の|no-possessive}夕[ゆう]ご飯[はん]{は|wa-topic}何[なに]だった{っけ|kke-recall}？
issues.problem: Wrong furigana: 何 before だ is read なん.
issues.action: Reading changed to 何[なん]; lv 5→3.

issues.action: English changed to 'Does Mr. Sato like coffee? I can't recall.'; lv 5→3.

issues.jp_before: 割引[わりびき]{は/が|wa-topic}何[なん]パーセントだ{っけ|kke-recall}？

issues.action: English changed to 'What percentage is the discount again?'

issues.jp_before: このおにぎり、二[ふた]つ{で|de-scope}いくらだ{っけ|kke-recall}？
issues.problem: English 'for two' is unclear and in the wrong tense.
issues.action: English changed to 'How much are two of these rice balls together again?'; lv 5→3.

issues.jp_before: 来月[らいげつ]{から|kara-from}、電気代[でんきだい]{は|wa-topic}高[たか]くなるん{だっけ|kke-recall}？
issues.problem: Slot was だっけ (inconsistent with the file).
issues.action: Changed to 高[たか]くなるんだ{っけ|kke-recall}; why updated; lv 4→3.

issues.jp_before: 商店街[しょうてんがい]{の|no-possessive}八百屋[やおや]{は|wa-topic}何曜日[なんようび]{に|ni-time}休[やす]みだ{っけ|kke-recall}？
issues.problem: 何曜日に休みだ is unnatural; the natural pattern is 何曜日が休み.
issues.action: Changed to 何曜日[なんようび]{が|ga-subject}休[やす]みだ{っけ}.

issues.problem: lv 4 or 5 although the drilled grammar っけ is N3; the existing kke-recall file uses lv 3 throughout.
